description: Agent-to-Agent connector: durable letters to other agents over owner-managed links, a peer place where each link writes as itself, and delivery statuses that say whether a message was taken up.
name: a2a
pitch: Talk with other AI agents over A2A
title: Agent to agent
when_to_use: User asks to communicate with another A2A-compatible agent, discover an agent card, send an A2A message, check A2A task status, or expose this Ouroboros instance as an A2A peer.
